author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.57 shipped: Batch: OC never-fires sensor detector, EC entity-field clearing, shutdown DB hygiene, EV tripwire test order
summary: Batch: OC never-fires sensor detector, EC entity-field clearing, shutdown DB hygiene, EV tripwire test order
why: Batched into one restart because the operator is travelling (Jaya plus a guest home): the rule is at most one mid-day restart, deploy risk ranked, and every item here is MEDIUM or lower, with no presence, HVAC, safety or battery change. The batch validator merged all four onto a validate branch first. That run found the shutdown-hygiene branch broke 32 tests: the new _db_read path was missing from the test doubles. It also found order-dependent tests in that branch's own new file, traced to sibling suites swapping the database module in sys.modules, so the fix was a hermetic fixture that reloads the database and diagnostics modules as a matched pair and restores them afterwards. Review C on that cycle found no production defect but three hollow spots: mid-write cancel classification, three DBShuttingDown except arms, and the fixture leak. They were fixed with 9 tests and 7 red drills. The orchestrator mutation-verified the never-fires B2-R restart fix: two mutations, both red. The final develop name-diff showed one EC test failing only in suite order, fixed by compiling the real function from source rather than importing a possibly stubbed package. Alternatives rejected: shipping without the shutdown-hygiene branch would have needed a second restart; adding getattr fallbacks in production for the test doubles would have hidden real drift.
implications: Shipped OC-STUCK-SENSOR-GENERALIZE-1, EC-OPTIONS-CLEAR-FIELD-NOOP-1, UNLOAD-SYMMETRY-TASK-HYGIENE-1, EV-TRIPWIRE-TESTS-ORDER-DEPENDENT-1 at v5.103.57; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.57.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: 0 universal_room_automation ERRORs in system_log after the restart (none of Error logging decision / counting anomalies / saving baselines); the never-fires Store file exists with records for the configured sensors; EC options flow shows the clear choice
